note: Attacker-controlled MQTT CONNACK bytes from rx_buf are consumed through rx_payload and drive the property decoding.
Property length is decoded from the reused CONNACK; for the second packet props_len is 0 so optional property parsing is skipped.

The decoder never initializes connect_ack->props = NULL before optional property parsing; when props_len == 0 the stale props pointer from the previously decoded (and already freed) connection acknowledgment is retained.
The reused connection acknowledgment's stale props pointer is passed to the property cleanup routine.
Property cleanup frees the stale property list for the reused acknowledgment.
MqttProps_Free dereferences and writes through the stale head pointer, causing a write to an invalid/freed memory location.
